segments.contextAfter: `body`: A closure that takes a  typed buffer to the same memory as this buffer, only bound to type `T`. The buffer parameter contains a number of complete instances of `T` based on the capacity of the original buffer and the stride of `Element`. The closure’s buffer argument is valid only for the duration of the closure’s execution. If `body` has a return value, that value is also used as the return value for the `withMemoryRebound(to:_:)` method.
